findings.claim: DepthStep now uses `>` instead of `>=`, so the depth limit is off by one. With MaximumObjectGraphDepth = N, a reader already at depth N can step into level N+1 without an exception, which weakens the stack-depth guard (L9). The change is unrelated to REQ-2234, which is about analyzer diagnostics under SuppressSourceGeneration. Concrete input: WithMaximumObjectGraphDepth(3), reader.Depth = 3, then DepthStep throws on base and does not throw on head.

The generated formatter serializes only the first member, so the second member's data is lost on round-trip, and the dynamic resolver rejects the same type at run time.
